description: This file contains unit tests for the ElasticSearchIndexer class within the SuiteCRM project. It tests various methods including indexing, removal, connection checks, and index management, and references external dependencies such as the Elasticsearch PHP client and mocking utilities.

classes.name: ElasticSearchIndexerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ElasticSearchIndexer, extends SearchTestAbstract to provide test cases for indexing, removal, connectivity, and index management functionalities.

methods.name: testGetModulesToIndex
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of modules to index, asserting the result is an array containing 'Contacts'.

methods.name: testIndexBeans
methods.description: Tests indexing multiple beans with mocked Elasticsearch client and verifies the counts of indexed and removed records.

methods.name: testGettersAndSetters
methods.description: Tests setting and getting batch size and index name properties of ElasticSearchIndexer.

methods.name: testIndexBean
methods.description: Tests indexing a single bean, ensuring no exceptions are thrown.

methods.name: getTestBean
methods.description: Helper method to create a test bean instance from a JSON file.

methods.name: testMakeIndexParamsFromBean
methods.description: Ensures the method producing index parameters from a bean produces the expected header and body.

methods.name: getExpectedHeader
methods.description: Returns the expected header array for index parameters.

methods.name: getExpectedBody
methods.description: Returns the expected body array for index parameters.

methods.name: testMakeIndexParamsBodyFromBean1
methods.description: Tests creation of index parameters body from a bean with default documentifier.

methods.name: testMakeIndexParamsBodyFromBean2
methods.description: Tests creation of index parameters body from a bean with a custom documentifier.

methods.name: testRemoveBeans
methods.description: Tests bulk removal of beans from Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: testRemoveBean
methods.description: Tests removal of a single bean from Elasticsearch index.

methods.name: testMakeParamsHeaderFromBean
methods.description: Tests creation of header parameters from a bean.

methods.name: testRemoveIndex
methods.description: Tests deleting an existing index, mocking Elasticsearch indices client.

methods.name: getMockIndices
methods.description: Helper to create mock Elasticsearch client and indices namespace.

methods.name: testRemoveIndex2
methods.description: Tests deleting an index with a dynamically generated name.

methods.name: testDeleteAllIndexes
methods.description: Tests removal of all Elasticsearch indices, handling no exception scenario.

methods.name: testDeleteAllIndexes2
methods.description: Tests removal of all indices handling a specific exception.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up mock objects after each test.

methods.name: testPing
methods.description: Tests Elasticsearch connection check returning false.

methods.name: testPing2
methods.description: Tests Elasticsearch connection check returning true or numeric value.

methods.name: testCreateIndex
methods.description: Tests creating a new index without body parameters.

methods.name: testCreateIndexWithBody
methods.description: Tests creating a new index with specific mappings.
